items.name: Claude connector
items.description: Add the Citehound MCP server to Claude, Claude Code, Cursor or VS Code. Free and read-only, no account.

items.name: MCP Registry listing
items.description: The Citehound MCP server is published in the MCP Registry, with its 13 read-only tools described on the MCP page.

items.name: GitHub Action
items.description: The official Citehound GitHub Action scans a domain from a workflow and can fail a build when the score is below a number you set.

items.name: Public API
items.description: A JSON API with an OpenAPI description: scan, compare, crawler access and generated files with a free key, and monitoring, the fix list and exports on Pro, Fix and Beyond.
